name: POD SHUM DOZHDYA
source:
Semyon goes out in the evening for groceries but gets caught in a heavy downpour. Luck was on his side as he met his classmate Lena, who invited him to wait out the rain at her place.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3740571920]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗晚上出去买杂货，却遇到了倾盆大雨。幸运的是，他遇到了同学莉娜，莉娜邀请他去她家等雨停。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3740571920]Steam[/url]]
